gen-gf-comic-relief-switzer: Bold, uniform strokes in Comic Relief leave their bowls unfinished on one side. Switzer, tubular and tall in the waist, handles the steady text work that those loud display shapes were never made for.
gen-gf-comic-relief-work-sans: Commanding up top, with bowls left unfinished on one side. Comic Relief handles loud display moments, while Work Sans, a contemporary sans with a high mean line, takes over the quieter reading.
gen-gf-funnel-display-fs-bespoke-sans: Bespoke Sans reads sharp and refined, with generous gaps where curves meet stems. Funnel Display is the louder partner, spaghetti-like same-width strokes built to command a headline, while the body font keeps to quiet precision.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-abeezee: Funnel Display draws spaghetti-like strokes, all the same width. ABeeZee, friendly and neon-tube thick, sits below with a high mean line, giving a loud top and an approachable base.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-aldrich: Funnel Display draws every stroke like spaghetti, constant in width, with c tips that stop well short of touching. Aldrich, with its cupped round letters, can sit several sizes below.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-alexandria: Expressive strokes of uniform width fill Funnel Display. Alexandria is a sans with open terminals and a tall body, with short stems above and below, adding a softer partner underneath.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-amiko: Spaghetti lines, big attitude: Funnel Display keeps a monoline construction from end to end. And Amiko, a modern sans whose terminals point outward like tongs, gives it a low-stress text voice.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-anek-bangla: Same-width strokes frame every counter in Funnel Display, which is what makes it so commanding. Anek Bangla, with wide s curves and short ascenders, does the approachable work Funnel Display leaves alone.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-anek-devanagari: Cord-like and commanding, Funnel Display gives curves the same heft as stems. Anek Devanagari, a sans-serif with open letter mouths and a tall middle zone, keeps paragraphs moving smoothly.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-anek-gujarati: Ruled lines, loud personality: Funnel Display keeps a constant width throughout. Anek Gujarati, whose lowercase rivals the capitals and whose c gapes open, brings the pair its biggest strength: friendly legibility under a loud top.
